## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `ci`
- [ ] Touches a **sensitive area** (migration · evaluator/baseline · security · infra) — called out below

## Boundary & impact review

- [ ] The change names its affected tenant / data / security / evaluation boundary.
- [ ] New behavior has unit/integration/e2e/eval coverage appropriate to its risk.
- [ ] It does not log, trace, cache, or return sensitive data unintentionally.
- [ ] API, schema, migration, config, feature-flag, and rollback implications are documented.
- [ ] Any new model/prompt/router/evaluator policy is immutable, versioned, and has comparison evidence.
- [ ] Error, cancellation, timeout, retry, and degraded-dependency paths are considered.
- [ ] UI changes are accessible, responsive, and authorized server-side.
- [ ] Required docs / ADR / runbook / CHANGELOG updates are included.
